event_description: Join us for an interactive self-defense workshop led by Igneus Self Defense as we recognize Purple Thursday and promote personal safety, confidence, and empowerment. This hands-on workshop is designed for all experience levels and will teach practical self-defense techniques through guided instruction and partner drills to help you build confidence and retain what you learn. You’ll also gain valuable knowledge about situational awareness, setting boundaries, and developing the mindset needed to recognize and respond to potentially unsafe situations. Whether you’re looking to learn new skills, boost your confidence, or simply become more prepared, this workshop will provide a supportive environment where you can practice, ask questions, and leave feeling more empowered. No prior experience is necessary. Wear comfortable clothing that allows for movement and be ready to participate!
